method.source: The document discusses a commodity example. Its embedded executable configuration explicitly names Binance BTC futures with 1d chart and base periods. Both recorded BTC dates are inside that saved historical range. The exercised code reads depth and positions without consuming chart bars, enters at 0.015 BTC and retains the source 20x leverage setting. The native fixture confirms 10,000 USDT default capital and 200ms operation on GetDepth, GetPosition and market orders.
method.randomness: Independent four-hour cold starts at 06:00 UTC on 2021-05-01 and 2021-06-01. Preserve the three externally specified seed streams and their antithetic complements for both initial directions. The original Math.random seeds are unspecified and these are explicit stochastic benchmarks.
method.book: Use the price-ordered Binance futures snapshots published by Tardis. Every permitted market order matches full requested base size by sweeping known visible ask or bid volume at a snapshot with capture-local time no later than completion. Prices use integer cents and quantity uses thousandths of BTC. All 144,002 recorded grid rows match the prior five-level snapshots and separately captured best quotes. Displayed size and price are the execution bounds.
method.timing: Primary calls take 200ms as observed in the FMZ native fixture. A full parallel sensitivity adds 200ms to each market order, and re-evaluates every changed future order and account state. Delayed rows are separate. The five-level control preserves 22 early stops and 2 complete paths. These repeat exactly under top-25. Report performance only for complete runs.
method.economics: Current-position profit uses captured last trades, while marked performance and drawdown use recorded derivatives marks. Financing is applied at the first replay clock at or after the exact recorded venue settlement. Use the historical 0.04% taker fee, exact weighted average of observed accepted market sweep prices, signed official funding and allocated entry fees. Independent Decimal reconciliation verifies each order and ending cash. Test requires positive equity beyond initial margin throughout.
method.limits: All fills are modeled market sweeps of observed quantities. The benchmark assumes fixed observed books and the stated call delays. Venue impact, hidden liquidity and other market dates are outside the evidence. The 12 primary and 12 delayed benchmarks share data and are statistically dependent.
